text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Can you hear that? The race
hasn't even
started yet, but the crowd is
so loud it feels like
the ground is
shaking!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Japanese Derby! Now I get
how this
is totally different from other
races!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And now I can see it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can see exactly how things are gonna
go down
after the race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Easy win, landslide—absolute victory!
This year's
Derby champion is El Condor
Pasaaa!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I lost! What kind of training were
you doing,
El?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but then again, it makes sense that
someone
trying to be the world's
strongest racer could be
so fast...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I've been running
completely
different races and training
differently from
everyone else.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course that path has made me strong!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's race again! And again and again
and again! I
wanna keep racing you
forever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Yup, that's how it'll go, all
right...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today, I gotta show everyone what a
really strong
person can do!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course not! I'm always a good sport!
choice_data_list_en: Make sure you mind your manners.
Make sure you mind your manners, okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It might be obvious, but today I'm gonna
prove to
Spe that the world's strongest
racer is also the
strongest in our
generation!
